points.title: AHB read completes OKAY with data
points.condition: Data phase of an accepted non-rejected read ends with HREADYOUT=1, HRESP=OKAY and nonzero HRDATA

points.title: AHB read completes with two-cycle ERROR from RRESP
points.condition: Final cycle of a read data phase (non-rejected read) with HREADYOUT=1 and HRESP=ERROR

points.title: AHB write completes OKAY
points.condition: Data phase of an accepted non-rejected write ends with HREADYOUT=1 and HRESP=OKAY

points.title: AHB write completes with ERROR from BRESP
points.condition: Final cycle of a write data phase (non-rejected write) with HREADYOUT=1 and HRESP=ERROR

points.title: Rejected transfer ERROR second cycle
points.condition: Data phase of a locally rejected transfer with HREADYOUT=1 and HRESP=ERROR

points.title: Rejected transfer ERROR first cycle
points.condition: Data phase of a locally rejected transfer with HREADYOUT=0 and HRESP=ERROR

points.title: Accepted transfer with HMASTLOCK=1
points.condition: Address phase accepted (HSEL, HREADY, HTRANS[1]) with HMASTLOCK=1

points.title: Accepted transfer with HPROT[6]=1
points.condition: Address phase accepted with HPROT[6]=1

points.title: Accepted transfer with HSIZE>2 only
points.condition: Address phase accepted with HSIZE>2 and no other rejection cause

points.title: Accepted misaligned transfer only
points.condition: Address phase accepted, HSIZE 1 or 2, address not naturally aligned, no other rejection cause

points.title: Accepted reserved HPROT code only
points.condition: Address phase accepted with HPROT[5:2] in reserved set 0100,0101,1000..1101 and no other rejection cause

points.title: Rejected SEQ beat after captured fixed write prefix
points.condition: Rejected SEQ address phase accepted while the previous accepted beat was a non-rejected fixed-burst write

points.title: New legal transfer accepted during ERROR second cycle
points.condition: Legal (non-rejected) address phase accepted at an edge with HRESP=1 and HREADYOUT=1

points.title: IDLE transfer selected and ready
points.condition: HSEL=1, HREADY=1, HTRANS=IDLE

points.title: BUSY inside a fixed burst
points.condition: HSEL=1, HREADY=1, HTRANS=BUSY while a fixed burst has remaining beats

points.title: Fixed burst cut short by a new NONSEQ
points.condition: NONSEQ accepted while the previous fixed burst still had beats remaining

points.title: Fixed burst cut short by IDLE
points.condition: IDLE with HSEL and HREADY while a fixed burst still had beats remaining

points.title: Legal byte access at nonzero byte offset
points.condition: Legal accepted transfer with HSIZE=0 and HADDR[1:0]!=0

points.title: AHB master wait (HREADY low) with active transfer
points.condition: HSEL=1, HREADY=0, HTRANS[1]=1 (no acceptance)

points.title: Fixed 4-beat write burst fully accepted
points.condition: Last SEQ beat of a 4-beat (WRAP4/INCR4) non-rejected write accepted

points.title: Fixed 8-beat write burst fully accepted
points.condition: Last SEQ beat of an 8-beat (WRAP8/INCR8) non-rejected write accepted

points.title: Fixed 16-beat write burst fully accepted
points.condition: Last SEQ beat of a 16-beat (WRAP16/INCR16) non-rejected write accepted

points.title: Read/write direction switch in acceptance order
points.condition: Non-rejected accepted beat whose direction differs from the previous non-rejected accepted beat

points.title: WRAP burst beat at wrap address boundary
points.condition: SEQ beat of WRAP4/8/16 with HSIZE=2 whose address is aligned to the whole wrap size (address has wrapped)

points.title: SINGLE or undefined INCR write accepted
points.condition: Non-rejected write accepted with HBURST SINGLE or INCR

points.title: Device-E write accepted
points.condition: Non-rejected write accepted with HPROT[6:2]=00001

points.title: Non-bufferable fixed write burst beat accepted
points.condition: Non-rejected fixed-burst write beat accepted with HPROT[2]=0

points.title: Bufferable Normal fixed write burst beat accepted
points.condition: Non-rejected fixed-burst SEQ write beat with HPROT[2]=1 and HPROT[3]=1

points.title: Burst-scoped attributes change mid burst
points.condition: Non-rejected SEQ fixed-burst write beat whose HPROT or HNONSEC differs from the previous accepted beat

points.title: Back-to-back accepted beats
points.condition: Address phase accepted at two consecutive edges

points.title: Legal halfword access at upper half
points.condition: Legal accepted transfer with HSIZE=1 and HADDR[1]=1

points.title: AW stalled 3+ cycles then handshake
points.condition: AW handshake after AWVALID was high with AWREADY low for at least 3 consecutive cycles

points.title: W stalled 3+ cycles then handshake
points.condition: W handshake after WVALID was high with WREADY low for at least 3 consecutive cycles

points.title: AR stalled 3+ cycles then handshake
points.condition: AR handshake after ARVALID was high with ARREADY low for at least 3 consecutive cycles

points.title: Reset released after reset during write activity
points.condition: First cycle after reset release where reset was asserted while a write was in flight

points.title: Reset released after reset during read activity
points.condition: First cycle after reset release where reset was asserted while a read was in flight

points.title: AW handshake single-beat (AWLEN=0)
points.condition: AW handshake with AWLEN=0

points.title: AW handshake maximum burst (AWLEN=15)
points.condition: AW handshake with AWLEN=15

points.title: AW WRAP burst handshake
points.condition: AW handshake with AWBURST=WRAP and AWLEN>0

points.title: AW INCR burst ending exactly at 4 KiB boundary
points.condition: AW handshake with INCR, AWLEN>0 and start offset plus total bytes equal to 4096
